tier1.text: The supinator turns the forearm so the palm faces forward, a motion called supination. The forearm runs from the elbow to the wrist and contains the radius and ulna bones. During supination, the radius rotates until the radius and ulna lie parallel.

quotes.quote: This crossing over brings the radius and ulna into an X-shape position. Supination is the opposite motion, in which rotation of the radius returns the bones to their parallel positions and moves the palm to the anterior facing (supinated) position
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.
